verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's first-party docs present it as a drop-in OpenAI replacement. They tell developers to point an existing OpenAI SDK at https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai, set api_key to a DeepInfra token, and keep their code otherwise unchanged. The same docs also list setting `model` to a catalog model as a required third change, so base URL and key alone are not quite enough. Missing for 10: the story's 'only base URL and API key' does not hold because the model name must also change, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that SDK calls work unmodified.
